## 


## YOUR TRUSTED SALESFORCE PARTNER


With years of expertise in crafting high-performance Salesforce business applications, we seamlessly transition from being your offshore IT vendor to becoming your trusted partner. We specialize in designing, developing, and maintaining Salesforce business applications and AppExchange products. Partner with us for assured success and a risk-free journey.

[About Us](https://thinkvibes.com/#about)
[Schedule Free Consultation](https://thinkvibes.com/#contact)

## WHY CHOOSE US


#### Client Language


Over the years, we have learnt not to use geek language, but converse with our customers in the no-nonsense easy to understand business language, thus making the communication most effective.


#### Attitude


Our customers are our highest priority, and we do everything possible to deliver what the customer needs, even if that means going above and beyond. We do not have a Sales team, yet we grow because our customers are our brand advocates.


#### Fair & Honest


An organization thrives when it is transparent in its working, and treats it’s people with fairness and honesty. A happy and satisfied employee translates to a happy client, which is what we aim for.


#### Robust Dev Processes


We follow Agile principles to adjust dynamically changing priorities, backed by strong DevOps processes for scalable and stable deployments through continuous integration.


## Who We Are


We are a small yet very focused group of highly skilled professionals developing software applications on the Salesforce platform since 2007.Our aim is for our customers to see us as their reliable and trusted partners, and convert them into our customer advocates or brand evangelists.


### Our Mission


We provide software development and consulting services to our clients. We aim for our customers to see us as their reliable and trusted partners, and convert them into our customer advocates or brand evangelists, as there is no better marketing than word of mouth. We achieve this by realizing the full potential of the Salesforce platform by delivering high-performing and scalable applications that can stand the test of time


### Our Vision

To become one of the most trusted Salesforce implementation partner for global clients in less than 10 years; and to provide exponential growth to those who trusted and joined us in our initial years, who we expect in turn will help create career and growth opportunities for others

### Our Values

Working with highest levels of commitment, ethics, honesty, integrity, and transparency; develop culture of owning the mistakes made, learning from it, and ensuring to not repeat them in future; delivering exceptional quality work with the help of multi-skilled teams, helping individuals learn new skills and make them reach their full potential.

## What We Do


#### Salesforce Consulting


With the help of our prior CRM experience, we help organizations overcome specific CRM challenges like low sales productivity, CRM performance issues. With our expertise, we help our customers draw the maximum out of the OOTB features and leverage the platform to the fullest. We provide guidance both strategic and technical in your Salesforce implementation journey.


#### Salesforce Customization


We offer customization services that help in improving the overall internal and external business processes of our clients’ business, and cater to business needs that can’t be addressed through the standard out-of-the-box platform features or other normal CRM applications. These applications are usually complex, and used in managing errands, like delivery planning, personnel and performance management, etc.


#### Salesforce Application Development


We help organizations in managing their internal business processes and operations by providing custom application development services on the Salesforce platform. We address business needs in all industry domains including but not limited to healthcare, manufacturing, retail, professional services, supplier relationship, warranty, finance, and technology.


#### Salesforce Integration


We offer reliable, secure, scalable, and seamless Salesforce integration with your other internal business apps. We also help organizations expose their business processes through API development that they can utilize in their other internal business applications. We also help you develop AppExchange published adaptors that can be used to connect your solutions with the Salesforce.


## Glimpses of workplace


People rarely succeed unless they have fun in what they are doing


## How We Work


Agile is in our DNA and we live and breathe it on a day to day basis, and so the final version of the application that we develop and deliver has all the requirements captured and developed as per the end vision of business stakeholders, and takes care of the evolving requirements and real time feedback during the application development journey.

/* ========================================

======================================== */

.partner-directory{

    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    gap:30px;

}

   CARD
======================================== */

.partner-directory a.partner-card{

    display:block;

    width:100%;

    min-height:260px;

    padding:40px;

    background:#fff;

    border:1px solid #e5e5e5;

    border-radius:18px;

    text-decoration:none;

    transition:.3s;

    box-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.05);

}

.partner-directory a.partner-card:hover{

    transform:translateY(-5px);

    box-shadow:0 15px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.12);

    border-color:#0b63ce;

}

/* ========================================
   CONTENT
======================================== */

.partner-content{

    display:flex;

    justify-content:space-between;

    align-items:center;

    gap:50px;

}

/* ========================================
   TEXT
======================================== */

.partner-text{

    flex:1;

}

.partner-text h3{

    font-size:32px;

    color:#111;

    margin-bottom:18px;

    font-weight:700;

}

.partner-text p{
    color:#666;
    font-size:18px;
    line-height:1.8;
    margin-bottom:35px;
    max-width:100%;
}

/* ========================================

======================================== */

.btn-button{
    display: inline-flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;

    width: 180px;
    height: 52px;

    padding: 5 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;

    background: #0b63ce !important;
    color: #fff !important;

    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 0 !important;
    text-align: center !important;
    white-space: nowrap;

    border-radius: 10px;
    text-decoration: none !important;

    box-sizing: border-box;
}
.partner-card:hover .btn-button{

    background:#084fa6;

}

/* ========================================
   LOGO
======================================== */

.partner-logo{

    flex:0 0 420px;

    display:flex;

    justify-content:center;

    align-items:center;

}

.partner-logo img{

    display:block !important;

    width:360px;

    max-width:100%;

    height:auto;

    object-fit:contain;

}
